name: Vellm
tagline: The operating system for high-volume wedding vendors and enterprise event groups.
positioning: Vellm consolidates bookings, contracts, and vendor coordination into one system of record built for multi-location wedding operations.

hero.h1: Run every wedding like your best wedding.
hero.sub: Vellm gives enterprise wedding vendors a single system of record for inquiries, contracts, timelines, and vendor handoffs — across every venue, planner, and market you operate.

features.title: Unified booking pipeline
features.description: Track every inquiry from first form fill to signed contract across all locations, with lead routing that assigns the right coordinator instantly.

features.title: Contract & deposit engine
features.description: Generate branded proposals, e-sign agreements, and reconcile deposit schedules automatically — no more spreadsheets chasing balances due.

features.title: Timeline orchestration
features.description: Build the day-of run sheet once and sync it to florists, caterers, and photographers so every vendor works from the same source of truth.

features.title: Portfolio-wide reporting
features.description: See booking velocity, average contract value, and coordinator utilization across your entire venue group in one executive dashboard.

features.title: Vendor network directory
features.description: Manage preferred-vendor rosters, insurance certificates, and commission agreements with automated renewal and compliance alerts.

features.title: Client concierge portal
features.description: Give couples a single branded portal for payments, questionnaires, and guest counts — reducing inbound email by up to 40%.

testimonials.quote: We onboarded eleven venues onto Vellm in a single quarter. Coordinator handoffs that used to live in email now happen in the platform, and our deposit reconciliation is finally clean.
testimonials.name: Danielle Ferraro

testimonials.quote: Vellm gave our leadership team the first real portfolio view we've ever had. We can see booking velocity by market and reallocate staff before a peak weekend hits.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The contract and deposit engine paid for itself in a season. We stopped losing revenue to missed balance-due dates across our forty-vendor network.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For boutique studios standardizing their first pipeline.
For venue groups and hospitality portfolios.

homepage.footerBlurb: Vellm is the system of record for enterprise wedding operations — bookings, contracts, and vendor coordination, unified across every venue you run.
